items.name: Elite plot 1
items.note: Place separate elite housing here. Target: Estate, 20 residents. The boulevard gives road access across its planted verge. Water is supplied on site.

items.name: Fish Pond
items.note: Permanent rear beauty reserve. Build before the elite plot. The pond is decorative; it does not distribute drinking water.

items.name: Museum
items.note: One per city. Requires curators from a road-connected University in the support yard. Both the building and actual curator visits matter.

items.name: Observatory
items.note: Requires trained astronomers from a University. Its roaming astronomers serve this street.

items.name: Bibliotheke
items.note: Produces scholars directly when staffed.

items.name: Laboratory
items.note: Requires inventors from an Inventors’ Workshop. The workshop itself is in the support yard.

items.name: Tax Office
items.note: Requires the city's Palace. Tax collection is not an evolution requirement.

items.name: Maintenance Office
items.note: Keep staffed before occupying houses. Superintendent visits reduce fire and collapse risk throughout the street.

items.name: Infirmary
items.note: Healers serve all eight elite plots along the street. Included for health, especially on higher difficulties; health is separate from the culture score.

items.name: Watchpost · optional
items.note: Optional: elite homes reduce unrest in the model. This is a reserve for local security, not a housing upgrade requirement.

items.name: Grand Agora
items.note: Build across the existing straight road, with three 2×2 stalls on each side. Roadblock goes immediately beyond its eastern end, not between the Agora and the homes.

items.name: Infirmary

workers.description: Sixteen 2×2 common homes, each with direct road frontage, support the city workforce. Maximum 960 residents is population, not a promise of 960 available workers. Add homes when the employment panel shows a shortage.

support.name: Shared supply & training yard

items.name: University
items.note: Starter allowance: one trainer for each district. Watch actual arrivals and add capacity if a venue waits for trainees.

items.name: University
items.note: Starter allowance: one trainer for each district. Watch actual arrivals and add capacity if a venue waits for trainees.

items.name: Inventors’ Workshop
items.note: Trains the specialist who walks through roadblocks to the service venue. Keep a continuous road to both districts.

items.name: Inventors’ Workshop
items.note: Trains the specialist who walks through roadblocks to the service venue. Keep a continuous road to both districts.

items.name: Granary
items.note: Food vendor buyers collect here. Accept only foods you actually produce or import; set getting orders when relying on a distant distribution hub.

items.name: Storehouse · household goods
items.note: Reserve bays for fleece, olive oil and wine. Use receiving/getting orders appropriate to your supply network.

items.name: Storehouse · armor & ranch supplies
items.note: Reserve armor and wheat for the Horse Ranch; wheat stored here is not citizen food. In Atlantis also reserve factory wood. Finished chariots come from the Chariot Factory; a warehouse of wood alone cannot supply an elite home.

items.name: Maintenance Office
items.note: Protects the supply and training buildings.

items.name: Palace
items.note: One per city, required for taxation and military organization. If already built, keep the existing Palace and omit this copy.

items.name: Maintenance Office
items.note: A second office provides overlap around the shared civic and storage facilities.

items.name: Watchpost · optional
items.note: Optional security capacity.

support.description: Connect this road to the right-hand city exits of both housing districts. Put the junctions outside the district roadblocks. Farms, industry, ranches and trade buildings depend on the map and are additional to this yard.

elite.name: Eight-estate promenade

items.name: Elite plot 1
items.note: Place separate elite housing here. Target: Estate, 20 residents. The boulevard gives road access across its planted verge. Water is supplied on site.

items.name: Fish Pond
items.note: Permanent rear beauty reserve. Build before the elite plot. The pond is decorative; it does not distribute drinking water.

items.name: Stadium, rotated
items.note: One per city. Rotate the 10×5 footprint to 5×10. Needs competitors from a Gymnasium. Its roaming competitors serve this street.

items.name: Theater
items.note: Needs actors trained at a road-connected Drama School.

items.name: Podium

items.name: Gymnasium
items.note: Produces athletes and sends competitors to the Stadium.

items.name: Tax Office
items.note: Requires the city's Palace. Tax collection is not an evolution requirement.

items.name: Maintenance Office
items.note: Keep staffed before occupying houses. Superintendent visits reduce fire and collapse risk throughout the street.

items.name: Infirmary
items.note: Healers serve all eight elite plots along the street. Included for health, especially on higher difficulties; health is separate from the culture score.

items.name: Watchpost · optional
items.note: Optional: elite homes reduce unrest in the model. This is a reserve for local security, not a housing upgrade requirement.

workers.description: Sixteen 2×2 common homes, each with direct road frontage, support the city workforce. Maximum 960 residents is population, not a promise of 960 available workers. Add homes when the employment panel shows a shortage.

support.name: Shared supply & training yard

items.name: College
items.note: Starter allowance: one trainer for each district. Watch actual arrivals and add capacity if a venue waits for trainees.

items.name: College
items.note: Starter allowance: one trainer for each district. Watch actual arrivals and add capacity if a venue waits for trainees.

items.name: Drama School
items.note: Trains the specialist who walks through roadblocks to the service venue. Keep a continuous road to both districts.

items.name: Drama School
items.note: Trains the specialist who walks through roadblocks to the service venue. Keep a continuous road to both districts.

items.name: Granary
items.note: Food vendor buyers collect here. Accept only foods you actually produce or import; set getting orders when relying on a distant distribution hub.

items.name: Storehouse · household goods
items.note: Reserve bays for fleece, olive oil and wine. Use receiving/getting orders appropriate to your supply network.

items.name: Storehouse · armor & ranch supplies
items.note: Reserve armor and wheat for the Horse Ranch; wheat stored here is not citizen food. In Atlantis also reserve factory wood. Finished chariots come from the Chariot Factory; a warehouse of wood alone cannot supply an elite home.

items.name: Maintenance Office
items.note: Protects the supply and training buildings.

items.name: Palace
items.note: One per city, required for taxation and military organization. If already built, keep the existing Palace and omit this copy.

items.name: Maintenance Office
items.note: A second office provides overlap around the shared civic and storage facilities.

items.name: Watchpost · optional
items.note: Optional security capacity.

support.description: Connect this road to the right-hand city exits of both housing districts. Put the junctions outside the district roadblocks. Farms, industry, ranches and trade buildings depend on the map and are additional to this yard.
